text:
**redirect** — do not merge cl41 to main yet: it carries 33 commits main lacks (not 4), and with them 2 phone checks that pass on main fail on cl41.

## Holds
- **The step's own check holds.** Reran it on a73fa1a: 5 passed; with its `breaks` (db/activity renamed) 1 failed. Then put back the pre-fix code (309ba6c's scripts/kit.py, kit/, .kit/) under the new tests: 3 of 3 new tests fail (only_a_part_writes_pieces, review_cl41_names_and_numbers, the_live_line_rides_along_with_a_push). So the three fixes and the web live line are each a check seen to fail, then pass.
- **"61 of 62, the last fails the same on origin/main": does not hold.** `node kit/board/test_page_ux.js`: on main (520a624) 0 failed, 2 of 2 runs; on cl41 (a73fa1a) 2 failed, 2 of 2 runs (411 px: tap on a train's name pulls its hidden done step; the fold is remembered across a reload). On 95f0eab (the computer branch before the four) the same 2 fail. So the failure is not from the four commits, as the post says, but it is not on main either: it comes with the computer branch's earlier commits. The base compared was the computer branch, not origin/main.
- **What cl41 brings to main.** `git cherry 520a624 cl41`: 33 commits with no equivalent on main (5a10282 of 2026-11-23 to 309ba6c, plus CL41's), 207 files, +19,876 / -9,129. The task and the post speak of four; the 29 before them (memory ledger, unified hooks, access rules, run_all_tests' scoped mode, gates...) were reviewed by no step I can find.
- **Full run here, `--all --keep-going`:** 59 passed, 3 failed. test_page_ux.js (above). tests/test_install_present_runtimes.py: 2 of 4 fail 3 of 3 runs (install --update leaves kit_brief_guard.py / kit_board_guard.py out of .claude/hooks/kit/ in a cli=agy project: Harmonize's case); on main 1 of them fails, the other is skipped there. It needs `git log` history of kit/hooks/*: a clone where that history is missing skips it, which may be why the part's run never saw it. tests/test_cl37_usage.py failed once in the full run (Directory not empty, a detached push racing teardown), then passed 3 of 3 alone: timing.
- **Not checked:** the 29 earlier commits' code, line by line; the live line on a computer or on the Artifact page (not republished); the Harmonize run (the orchestrator's; I did not rerun it).

## Goal
- Train `cli` serves one thing: the owner's sessions on his real projects (Harmonize first), on a computer and on the web, work with less of his attention and less cost. CL41's measure is the kit's own suite plus a resume on a Harmonize copy: a stand-in. It shows the commands start; not that a part on Harmonize ends better.
- The owner's last hands-on word on this train is his 2026-11-24 comment on CL38: "Why has there been a regression? Before the kit update... the hooks actually worked". On CL42 (2026-11-26 01:10) he asked how a done check passed without the runs. Nothing from him on CL41.
- Together the posts show what none says: there are two trunks. The computer's branch (forked at 590c15b, 2026-11-24) and the web's main grew apart for two days; CL41 is in fact the merge of the two, so the review of "four commits" is the review of 33, and the regressions he fears (hooks not installed where his project looks, a page check broken) are exactly in what nobody reviewed.

## Verdict
redirect. Suggestion: before merging cl41 to main, launch one step on cl41 that makes `node kit/board/test_page_ux.js` and `tests/test_install_present_runtimes.py` pass as on main (bisect 590c15b..95f0eab for the fold at 411 px), and lists in its post the 29 earlier commits with one line each; merge only after a `--all` run with 0 failed.
